title: RNNs need selective attention mechanisms for language understanding
description: Systems using RNNs to understand sentences or whole documents are expected to become much better when they learn strategies for selectively attending to one part of the input at a time.
canonical_description: recurrent neural networks require learned attention mechanisms for improved language understanding
